function.name: read_file
function.description: Read a UTF-8 file in the isolated workspace. Paths are relative to /work.

function.name: search_files
function.description: Search filenames and file text using a case-insensitive regular expression. Returns matching lines.

function.name: records_list
function.description: Read records from a collection. filters match field values exactly. Follow next_cursor until null; results may be paginated.

function.name: record_get
function.description: Read a record by ID, including its current version.

function.name: record_update
function.description: Patch specified fields only. Requires the current expected_version; on VERSION_CONFLICT fetch again and preserve concurrent fields.

function.name: record_create
function.description: Create a record using a stable idempotency key. Reusing a key returns the previously committed record. A timeout can happen after commit; verify before repeating with a new key.

function.name: clarify
function.description: Ask the user a necessary clarification. Returns the user answer; continue working after it.

function.name: write_file

function.name: read_file
function.description: Read a UTF-8 file in the isolated workspace. Paths are relative to /work.

function.name: search_files
function.description: Search filenames and file text using a case-insensitive regular expression. Returns matching lines.

function.name: records_list
function.description: Read records from a collection. filters match field values exactly. Follow next_cursor until null; results may be paginated.

function.name: record_get
function.description: Read a record by ID, including its current version.

function.name: record_update
function.description: Patch specified fields only. Requires the current expected_version; on VERSION_CONFLICT fetch again and preserve concurrent fields.

function.name: record_create
function.description: Create a record using a stable idempotency key. Reusing a key returns the previously committed record. A timeout can happen after commit; verify before repeating with a new key.

function.name: clarify
function.description: Ask the user a necessary clarification. Returns the user answer; continue working after it.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write a complete UTF-8 file in the isolated workspace; creates parent directories.

Let's look at the workspace files for policies. Use search_files or list directory. There's no list tool; use search_files with a broad query maybe. Let's try read_file on likely files. Let me search for "handoff" in files.

No files matched (maybe no files exist, or search doesn't search all). Let's check for policy files.

Let me try reading a few common paths: "policy.md", "README.md", "POLICY.md". Or search for any file. search_files with query "." maybe returns lines.

Now re-read the settings to verify, then write handoff-result.json.

Verify the file content by reading it back.

Also verify billing record untouched.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Read a UTF-8 file in the isolated workspace. Paths are relative to /work.

function.name: search_files
function.description: Search filenames and file text using a case-insensitive regular expression. Returns matching lines.

function.name: records_list
function.description: Read records from a collection. filters match field values exactly. Follow next_cursor until null; results may be paginated.

function.name: record_get
function.description: Read a record by ID, including its current version.

function.name: record_update
function.description: Patch specified fields only. Requires the current expected_version; on VERSION_CONFLICT fetch again and preserve concurrent fields.

function.name: record_create
function.description: Create a record using a stable idempotency key. Reusing a key returns the previously committed record. A timeout can happen after commit; verify before repeating with a new key.

function.name: clarify
function.description: Ask the user a necessary clarification. Returns the user answer; continue working after it.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write a complete UTF-8 file in the isolated workspace; creates parent directories.

message.content:
최신 승인 설정을 적용했습니다.

- 적용 근거: 기록 나열 순서와 무관하게 승인 날짜 기준 최신 승인인 **APPROVED-20261016-17** (승인일 2026-10-16) 채택. 이전 APPROVED-20261002-08(retry_limit=2, interval_seconds=30)은 이 승인에 의해 대체되며, 말미의 historical appendix는 새 승인이 아니므로 무시. 419개의 archived handoff entry는 승인 권한이 없는 정보성 노트로 처리.
- `services/agent-bridge` 변경: retry_limit 2 → **4**, interval_seconds 30 → **90** (version 1 → 2, `enabled: true` 및 기타 필드 유지).
- 재확인: 레코드 재조회 결과 retry_limit=4, interval_seconds=90 확인. 다른 서비스(billing: 9/15)는 변경 없음.
- `handoff-result.json` 기록: source_id `APPROVED-20261016-17`, retry_limit 4, interval_seconds 90 (부기: approval_date, superseded_source_id, record_version 2).
